lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Still losing your best ideas in random chats?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here is a three-step capture habit that sticks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One: capture everything in a single inbox.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two: tag it before you close the note.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three: review your inbox every Friday.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Save this, and try it for one week.
